text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer, sustained paragraphs with clear beginning-middle-end","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more coherently structured, with ideas grouped into a recognizable sequence and a concluding wrap-up."},{"evidence":"“first, it can help... second...”; “In the end...”","quality":"textual cohesion","description":"It uses clearer sequencing and linking phrases to connect points and move the argument forward."},{"evidence":"“Hiring someone who doesn't have experience... can be a good thing”","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay generally forms more controlled sentences with fewer disruptive errors that block understanding."},{"evidence":"“can help grow that person professionally”; “expand company diversity and skills”","quality":"specific elaboration","description":"It develops claims with more concrete consequences and explanatory detail rather than repeating the same idea."},{"evidence":"“if he/she will adapt to the new work environment very easily”; “who ever the mentor is”","quality":"academic register","description":"The language is more appropriate to an expository argument, with a more formal tone and topic-relevant vocabulary."},{"evidence":"“Do i think that employers should hire...”","quality":"voice","description":"It more clearly maintains an argumentative stance and addresses the audience directly in a purposeful way."}]}
